newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Oil mulls electricity sales.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Oil mulls electricity sales.

text.p: Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd said on Friday it was considering taking part in four wholesale electricity tenders this fiscal year, as part of an effort to improve profits.
"A final decision has yet to be reached but we are considering the possibility," a Mitsubishi Oil spokesman said.

If awarded tenders to be issued by Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc, Kansai Electric Power Co Inc, Tohoku Electric Power Co Inc and Chugoku Electric Power Co Inc, the refiner would construct four 150,000 kilowatt generators and burn residual fuel to produce electricity, the spokesman said.

Electric utilities issued their first wholesale electricity tenders last year, following deregulation in the power industry in December 1995. Mitsubishi Oil took part in a tender by Kansai Electric Power but failed to win.
The oil industry, struggling to prop up profits battered by slumping retail gasoline prices, has been eager to sell electricity and make use of surplus residual fuel.
In February, Mitsubishi Oil revised its parent forecast for the year to March 31 to a current loss of 9.50 billion yen from an earlier forecast of an eight billion yen profit.
